example: The bridge is still under construction, so we must take another road.
example_translation: 这座桥仍在施工，我们必须走另一条路。

example: We asked a safety consultant to inspect the old building.
example_translation: 我们请一位安全顾问检查这座旧建筑。

example: The plan changed after consultation with local residents.
example_translation: 经过与当地居民磋商，这项计划有了变动。

example: Old lamps consume more electricity than these new ones.
example_translation: 旧灯比这些新灯耗电更多。

example: The school reduced its water consumption during the summer.
example_translation: 学校在夏季减少了用水量。

example: Please contact the museum before you arrange the visit.
example_translation: 安排参观前，请联系博物馆。

example: This box may contain fragile glass, so carry it carefully.
example_translation: 这个箱子可能装有易碎玻璃，请小心搬运。

example: The gallery displays contemporary art from several countries.
example_translation: 这家画廊展出来自几个国家的当代艺术作品。

example: We discussed the content of the report before changing its title.
example_translation: 修改标题前，我们讨论了报告的内容。
note: 名词重音在首音节；不是满意的形容词

example: Our class entered a writing contest about life in the future.
example_translation: 我们班参加了一场关于未来生活的写作比赛。

example: Read the whole paragraph to understand the word in context.
example_translation: 读完整段，结合上下文理解这个单词。
note: in context；本批为语言语境义

example: The exhibition follows the history of trade across the continent.
example_translation: 这场展览追溯了整个大陆的贸易历史。

example: We decided to continue our journey after the rain stopped.
example_translation: 雨停后，我们决定继续旅程。
note: continue sth；也可接 to do 或 doing

example: Read the contract carefully before you sign your name.
example_translation: 签名前，请仔细阅读合同。
note: 名词重音在首音节；不是收缩动词

example: The two witnesses gave contradictory accounts of the event.
example_translation: 两名目击者对这件事作出了相互矛盾的描述。
note: 修饰彼此不一致的说法

example: Contrary to our expectations, the small team finished first.
example_translation: 与我们的预期相反，这支小队最先完成。

example: The contrast between the quiet village and the busy city is striking.
example_translation: 宁静村庄与繁忙城市之间的差异十分明显。
note: contrast between A and B；名词读音

example: Her contribution to the project helped everyone work more efficiently.
example_translation: 她对这个项目的贡献帮助大家提高了工作效率。

example: You can control the volume with the button on the side.
example_translation: 你可以用侧面的按钮控制音量。

example: The proposal was controversial, so the council invited further discussion.
example_translation: 这项提议有争议，因此议会邀请大家进一步讨论。

example: Is this a convenient time for us to discuss the plan?
example_translation: 现在方便一起讨论计划吗？
note: convenient 通常描述时间、地点或安排

example: The new design uses less space than a conventional engine.
example_translation: 这种新设计比常规发动机占用的空间更少。

example: A short conversation with the guide changed our route.
example_translation: 与向导的一次简短交谈改变了我们的路线。

example: A short letter can convey gratitude without using many words.
example_translation: 一封简短的信不必用很多文字就能表达感激。
note: convey a feeling/message；本批不是运输义

example: The evidence may convince them that the route is safe.
example_translation: 这些证据可能使他们相信这条路线是安全的。

example: We can cook a simple meal at the campsite tonight.
example_translation: 今晚我们可以在营地做一顿简单的饭。

example: She saved the last cookie for her younger brother.
example_translation: 她把最后一块曲奇饼干留给了弟弟。
note: 可数食物名词；不是网络 cookie 义

example: The air felt cool when we stepped out of the tent.
example_translation: 我们走出帐篷时，觉得空气凉爽。

example: The two schools will cooperate to organize the science fair.
example_translation: 这两所学校将合作举办科学展。

example: Please copy the address into your notebook before we leave.
example_translation: 出发前，请把地址抄进笔记本。
note: copy sth into...；不是一本或一份的名词

example: Trust is at the core of a strong friendship.
example_translation: 信任是牢固友谊的核心。
note: at the core of；本批为抽象核心义

example: The farmer planted corn in the field beside the river.
example_translation: 农民在河边的田地里种下了玉米。
note: 本例采用玉米义；不可数作物名词

example: We placed a small lamp in the corner of the room.
example_translation: 我们在房间角落放了一盏小灯。
note: in the corner；不是街角的 at the corner

example: The report explains the company's new corporate strategy.
example_translation: 这份报告说明了公司的新企业战略。

example: Check that the date is correct before sending the invitation.
example_translation: 发送邀请前，请检查日期是否正确。

example: The numbers on the map correspond to the labels in the guide.
example_translation: 地图上的数字与指南中的标注相对应。

example: The cost of repairing the roof was higher than we expected.
example_translation: 修理屋顶的费用比我们预期的更高。
note: the cost of doing sth；名词

example: Each actor checked their costume before going on stage.
example_translation: 每位演员在上台前都检查了自己的戏服。
note: 可数名词；本例为戏服义

example: We rented a cottage near the lake for the weekend.
example_translation: 我们在湖边租了一间乡间小屋过周末。

example: This shirt is made of cotton and feels soft.
example_translation: 这件衬衫是棉制的，摸起来很柔软。

example: Cover your mouth when you cough in a crowded room.
example_translation: 在拥挤的房间里咳嗽时，请捂住嘴。

example: When she was six, she could already swim across the small pool.
example_translation: 六岁时，她已经能游过那个小泳池。
note: 表示过去一般能力；后接动词原形

example: The town council approved a new public library.
example_translation: 镇议会批准新建一座公共图书馆。
note: 可数机构名词；区分 counsel

example: Count the bags before we load them onto the bus.
example_translation: 把包搬上公交车前，先清点一下。

example: Every country in the exhibition has its own display area.
example_translation: 展览中的每个国家都有自己的展示区。
note: 可数国家义；不是乡下义

example: We spent the afternoon walking through the countryside.
example_translation: 我们整个下午都在乡间漫步。

example: The walking route crosses the county boundary near the old bridge.
example_translation: 这条步行路线在旧桥附近穿过郡界。
note: 行政区域名词；各国制度不同

example: The couple who own the shop welcomed us warmly.
example_translation: 经营这家店的那对夫妇热情地欢迎了我们。
note: 本例指一对伴侣；不是几个的 a couple of

example: It took courage to admit the mistake in front of the whole class.
example_translation: 在全班面前承认这个错误需要勇气。
note: 不可数；It takes courage to do sth

example: She chose a course in environmental science for the next term.
example_translation: 她为下学期选择了一门环境科学课程。
note: 可数课程义；不是路线或一道菜

example: The witness answered questions in court the next morning.
example_translation: 第二天早上，证人在法庭上回答了问题。
note: in court；本例为司法场所义

meaning: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
example: My cousin lives nearby, so we often study together.
example_translation: 我的堂表亲住在附近，因此我们经常一起学习。
note: 英文词本身不区分性别和堂表关系

example: Cover the bowl with a clean cloth while the dough rests.
example_translation: 面团静置时，用一块干净的布盖住碗。
note: cover sth with sth；本批不是报道义

example: The newspaper provided detailed coverage of the rescue.
example_translation: 这家报纸对救援进行了详细报道。
note: 不可数报道义；不是保险保障义

example: The farmer led a cow back to the field.
example_translation: 农民把一头母牛牵回了田里。

example: The workshop teaches the traditional craft of making wooden toys.
example_translation: 这个工坊教授制作木制玩具的传统手艺。
note: 本批为手艺义；不是船或飞机

example: The empty cart began to roll and might crash into the wall.
example_translation: 空推车开始滑动，可能会撞上墙。
note: crash into；本批不是软件崩溃义

example: It would be crazy to cross the river during the storm.
example_translation: 暴风雨期间渡河是很不理智的。
note: 本例评价行为，不用于称呼精神疾病患者

example: Would you like a little cream with your dessert?
example_translation: 你的甜点要加一点奶油吗？
note: 不可数食物名词；不是乳霜或颜色义

example: The students hope to create a small garden behind the school.
example_translation: 学生们希望在学校后面建一个小花园。

example: The team found a creative solution using materials they already had.
example_translation: 团队利用已有材料找到了一个有创意的解决办法。

example: A tiny creature moved beneath the wet leaves.
example_translation: 一只小生物在湿叶下面移动。
note: 可数名词；不限定某一动物类别

example: The whole team deserves credit for completing the rescue.
example_translation: 整个团队都应因完成救援而获得赞扬。
note: deserve credit for；本批不是信贷义

meaning: 全体机组人员；全体船员
example: The pilot thanked the crew after the difficult flight.
example_translation: 这趟艰难的飞行结束后，飞行员感谢了全体机组人员。

example: The report describes a crime that happened near the station.
example_translation: 报告描述了一起发生在车站附近的犯罪行为。

example: The hospital remained open throughout the crisis.
example_translation: 这家医院在整个危机期间一直开放。

example: Safety is the main criterion for choosing a route.
example_translation: 安全是选择路线的主要标准。

example: Clean water is critical to the survival of the village.
example_translation: 清洁水源对村庄的生存至关重要。
note: critical to；本批不是批评的或病危义

example: The farmers protected the crop from the sudden frost.
example_translation: 农民保护庄稼免受突如其来的霜冻。
note: 可数作物名词；不是裁剪动词

example: We must cross the valley before the weather changes.
example_translation: 我们必须在天气变化前穿过山谷。

example: A small crowd gathered outside the theatre before sunset.
example_translation: 日落前，一小群人聚集在剧院外。

example: The guide's knowledge was crucial to our safe return.
example_translation: 向导的知识对我们安全返回至关重要。

example: It is cruel to leave an injured animal without help.
example_translation: 对受伤的动物不予救助是残忍的。

example: The child began to cry when the balloon flew away.
example_translation: 气球飞走时，孩子哭了起来。
note: 不及物哭泣义；不是大喊义

example: She sliced a cucumber to add to the salad.
example_translation: 她切了一根黄瓜，准备加进沙拉。

example: The festival celebrates local cuisine with food from nearby villages.
example_translation: 这个节日通过周边村庄的食物展示当地饮食特色。

example: The museum helps visitors learn about the region's culture.
example_translation: 这座博物馆帮助游客了解该地区的文化。

example: He placed a cup beside the kettle before making tea.
example_translation: 泡茶前，他在水壶旁放了一个杯子。

example: Keep the clean plates in the cupboard above the sink.
example_translation: 把干净的盘子放在水槽上方的橱柜里。
note: 可数家具名词；注意 p 不发音

example: The researchers hope to find a treatment that can cure the disease.
example_translation: 研究人员希望找到一种能治愈这种疾病的治疗方法。
note: cure a disease；本句表达研究希望，不作医疗承诺

example: The children were curious about the strange marks on the map.
example_translation: 孩子们对地图上的奇怪标记感到好奇。

example: You can exchange your currency at the desk near the entrance.
example_translation: 你可以在入口附近的柜台兑换货币。

example: Check the current timetable before you leave for the station.
example_translation: 出发去车站前，请查看当前时刻表。
note: 形容词；不是水流或电流名词

example: A thin curtain let soft light into the room.
example_translation: 一幅薄窗帘让柔和的光线透进房间。

example: The road follows a gentle curve beside the lake.
example_translation: 道路沿着湖边形成一段平缓的弯道。
note: 可数名词；本例为道路弯道

example: It is a local custom to welcome guests with warm tea.
example_translation: 用热茶迎接客人是当地习俗。
note: 可数习俗义；不是 customs 海关

example: The shopkeeper helped a customer choose a suitable coat.
example_translation: 店主帮助一位顾客挑选合适的外套。

example: Use a clean knife to cut the bread into equal pieces.
example_translation: 用一把干净的刀把面包切成大小相等的块。
note: cut sth into...；过去式和过去分词仍为 cut

example: The child drew a cute rabbit on the front of the card.
example_translation: 孩子在卡片正面画了一只可爱的兔子。

example: The diagram shows the life cycle of a butterfly.
example_translation: 这张图展示了蝴蝶的生命周期。
note: life cycle；名词，不是骑车动词

example: A daily walk helps her take a break from studying.
example_translation: 每天散步让她能从学习中休息片刻。
note: 本批为形容词；不是副词或日报名词

example: The engineers checked the dam after the heavy rain.
example_translation: 大雨过后，工程师检查了水坝。

example: The strong wind caused damage to several roofs.
example_translation: 强风损坏了几处屋顶。
note: 不可数；damage to sth；不是赔偿金 damages

example: The towels were still damp after a night in the tent.
example_translation: 在帐篷里放了一夜后，毛巾仍然潮湿。

example: The children learned to dance to the music at the festival.
example_translation: 孩子们在节日里学着随音乐跳舞。

example: The sign warns walkers of danger near the cliff.
example_translation: 这块标牌提醒步行者注意悬崖附近的危险。
note: warn sb of danger；本例不可数

example: The mountain road becomes dangerous when the surface freezes.
example_translation: 路面结冰时，这条山路会变得危险。
note: 形容词；与名词 danger 区分

example: Few travellers dare to cross the old bridge after dark.
example_translation: 很少有旅人敢在天黑后走过那座旧桥。
note: 普通动词 dare to do；本批不是情态用法

example: The room was too dark to read the map without a lamp.
example_translation: 房间太暗，没有灯就无法看地图。
note: 光线义；不是颜色深或名词

example: The team collected data on rainfall throughout the year.
example_translation: 团队全年收集降雨量数据。
note: 本例不涉及谓语单复数选择；数据名词
